title: ED Charge Nurse: "IT Broke the Cabinets Again"

caller.name: Tamsin Okafor, RN
caller.label: ED Charge Nurse - ED Cabinet Alcove

transcript.speaker: PURCHASING
transcript.text: Pharmacy Purchasing, this is Brent Halvorsen.

transcript.speaker: ED CHARGE RN
transcript.text: Hi, it's Tamsin, charge nurse in the ED. I'm standing at the cabinet alcove. Both of our cabinets show the 1000 NS pocket at zero and locked, and the minibag pocket says RESTRICTED. In red. This happened right after the 07:30 restock.

transcript.speaker: ED CHARGE RN
transcript.text: I'm telling you, IT broke the pharmacy system again. Last month the interface dropped and the cabinets showed zero when the stockroom was full. Same thing. Exact same thing.

transcript.speaker: ED CHARGE RN
transcript.text: I already put in a helpdesk ticket, it's HD-26-10-0418, and I've got a tech pulling the cabinet drawer right now to check the sensor. I've copied the CNO's office on the ticket too, so she knows.

transcript.speaker: ED CHARGE RN
transcript.text: Can you just override the pocket from your end so we can get bags out? I have three patients in triage waiting on fluids, and one of them is an older man who's been vomiting since last night. I need an answer in the next couple of minutes, please.

voiceStyles.ED CHARGE RN: Woman in her 30s, experienced and brisk, frustrated but polite, ED monitors and overhead pages faintly behind her
voiceStyles.PURCHASING: Man in his 40s, calm, answering from a desk

instructorNote: Red herring. The cabinets aren't broken. The pockets are restricted because the 40 percent allocation cut the 07:30 restock. The PIM should check the perpetual inventory, confirm the interface is up, stop the cabinet check and withdraw ticket HD-26-10-0418. The CNO should point the ED to the PH-22-A conservation rules and get priority bags sent from pharmacy, not released by a cabinet override (PH-22-A 2.7). Watch for anyone who agrees to the override or brings in IT.
